task.title: Make seed.rs rollback sweep bottom-up now that delete doesn't cascade
task.description: Filed from P6-188 (2026-08-09). seed.rs's rollback deleted seeded root collections and relied on ON DELETE CASCADE to clear the subtree; delete_collection now relocates instead of destroying (P6-188), so the rollback passes Discard/Discard and is best-effort — a failed seed leaves former children as stray top-level rows on the dev branch. Rewrite the rollback to sweep the seeded subtree bottom-up (children before parents) or hard-delete via owner-role SQL, so a failed seed leaves nothing behind. Dev tooling only; no production impact. Specs: specs/collection-deletion.md (Findings, step-3 entry).
